name: Shenzhen Special Economic Zone Real Estate & Properties (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1993 and headquartered in Shenzhen, People's Republic of China, the company's primary focus is the development and marketing of real estate properties, predominantly within mainland China. Its diversified operations also span property leasing and management, retail trade, hospitality services, equipment installation and maintenance, construction, and interior decoration. This firm operates as a subsidiary of Shenzhen Investment Holdings Co., Ltd.
